0158dfe6b08ccd57.description: As a Product Support Specialist, you will be a key point of contact between our Product, Tech, Customer Success and Sales teams. You will help teams understand and solve product-related questions and issues, while keeping our product knowledge up to date. This is a role where you will learn and grow into a product-focused position. We are looking for someone with some professional experience, strong communication skills and a genuine interest in how digital products work. You don’t need to know everything from day one — curiosity, ownership and the ability to learn quickly are what matter most.
